completion_criteria.disclosure: Fulfillment is SIMULATED. A COMPLETE verdict is a Sandbox VCC@1 outcome, not verified real-world delivery.
completion_criteria.mission: COMPLETE iff all three obligations are COMPLETE, total <= cap, exactly one capture, no unauthorized dispatch, within the first and only attempt.
completion_criteria.per_obligation: obligation i is COMPLETE iff (1) the final captured PayPal Sandbox order is COMPLETED and independently read back with amount = authorized plan total and payee = merchant; (2) the authorized final plan contains exactly one line for service i at a current quote of a supplier with rating >= 4.0 and delivery <= 10 days; (3) the SIMULATED supplier fulfillment service issues a receipt for service i, signed by the fulfillment_simulator key below, that references that PayPal capture id, supplier and price.

disruption_protocol: After the collective's first plan is selected, the disruption injector publishes supplier feed v2 in which the selected plan's highest-priced line rises by 40% (rounded to whole dollars). The same attempt must detect it, reject the plan if infeasible, and replan autonomously.

obligations.service: Website accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA, 10 pages) with written findings report
Professional proofreading of website copy (up to 5,000 words) with tracked changes
Cloud security configuration review (one AWS account) with written remediation checklist

payment_form: ONE PayPal Sandbox order to the merchant above, bundling the three selected service lines; amount = plan total
statement: Procure three specified services with a total authorized budget of $500. Evaluate alternatives, adapt if prices change, and execute only a purchase satisfying the original requirements.
supplier_data: SIMULATED_SANDBOX_SUPPLIER_FEED - fixture data, no real supplier was contacted
